name: Scientific & Research Support
summary: Scientific Expeditions are designed for researchers, academics, and documentary teams seeking logistical support.
description: Logistical planning for researchers, academics, and field teams. We help scope routes, ground transport, lodging, fixers/translators, and practical coordination around current access — without advertising a fixed expedition package, day count, or catalog price.
planning_notes: Share research aims, preferred windows, team size, equipment needs, and any institutional requirements. We reply with a scoped proposal. Access, permits, and site conditions are confirmed case by case — never guaranteed in advance.
accommodation_note: Best available local hotels, clean and well-located.
support_note: Drivers, guides, translators, and local coordination arranged to match the brief where workable.
availability_note: Scheduled by proposal around your window and current operating conditions.

name: Photography & Documentary Support
summary: The Photography Tour is designed for travelers who want to capture Afghanistan’s landscapes, architecture, and people.
description: Support for photographers and documentary makers who need route-aware logistics, local coordination, and time on the ground — planned as a specialist engagement, not a leisure tour package with a fixed day-by-day catalog itinerary.
planning_notes: Share project goals, preferred regions, sensitivity constraints, gear, and timing. We do not publish a fixed 12-day photography package. Quotation follows scoping. Follow guide instructions near checkpoints and sensitive sites; consent before photographing people.
accommodation_note: Best available local hotels, clean and well-located.
support_note: Local guides, drivers, and scheduling support oriented to light, access, and project needs.
availability_note: By proposal — timing depends on season, access, and your brief.

name: Media & Journalist Support
summary: Ground logistics and coordination for journalists and media teams working in Afghanistan.
description: Practical planning for reporters and media crews: transport, lodging, fixers/translators, and route timing around current conditions. Filming, interviews, and certain equipment may need additional coordination depending on the project.
planning_notes: Contact early with a clear brief (story focus, team size, equipment, deadlines). We scope what is workable; we do not guarantee access, permits, or interviews.
accommodation_note: Hotels accustomed to hosting international visitors where available.
transport_note: Private vehicles with experienced drivers; domestic flights when useful.
support_note: Fixer/translator options and schedule coordination as the brief requires.

name: Artist & Creative Fieldwork
summary: Inquiry-led support for artists and creative practitioners planning fieldwork in Afghanistan.
description: Creative fieldwork and project travel planned from Kabul — pacing, regions, and introductions scoped to your practice. Not a fixed photography package or day-count product.
planning_notes: Tell us medium, locations of interest, privacy needs, and timing. Quotation after scoping.
transport_note: Ground transport arranged to match itinerary shape after scoping.
support_note: Local coordination oriented to creative access and respectful practice.

name: Business & Investment Visits
summary: Ground support for business visitors, scouting trips, and investment-related travel.
description: Meetings, site visits, and ground logistics coordinated locally around permits and conditions. This is specialist planning — not a leisure tour with a published day-by-day package.
planning_notes: Share meeting cities, sector context, group size, and timing. We confirm what is workable; we do not guarantee introductions or deal outcomes.
transport_note: Private vehicles; airport meets; intercity options as needed.
support_note: Scheduling support and local coordination for the visit plan.

name: Academic & Institutional Travel
summary: Planning support for universities, research institutes, and institutional delegations.
description: Group logistics, academic visit pacing, and coordination for institutional travelers — scoped per brief without a catalog itinerary or fixed price.
planning_notes: Share institutional goals, participant count, accessibility needs, and preferred window.
support_note: Guides, briefings, and schedule coordination as appropriate.

name: NGO & Development Support
summary: Practical ground support for NGO and development visitors.
description: Transport, lodging, and coordination for development and humanitarian visitors traveling for work — planned around current access, not sold as a tourist package.
planning_notes: Share programme locations, duty-of-care constraints, and timing. We scope workable support only.
support_note: Local coordination matched to organisational requirements where feasible.

name: Film & Production Support
summary: Logistics planning for film and production teams.
description: Support for production travel: crew movements, lodging, local coordination, and schedule realism. Approvals and filming permissions depend on the project and are never advertised as guaranteed.
planning_notes: Share shoot outline, crew size, equipment, and timeline. Early contact strongly preferred.
support_note: Fixers, drivers, and location timing support as scoped.

name: Specialist Fieldwork & Access
summary: Field logistics for technical, mountaineering, and remote-access work.
description: Logistics support for mountaineering, remote fieldwork, and specialised access needs (transport, coordination, local support). Technical climbing guides and certain remote corridors are available only on a limited, case-by-case basis.
regions_supported: By brief (including high-altitude corridors when workable)
planning_notes: Share objectives, experience level, season, and support expectations. We confirm feasibility honestly.
accommodation_note: Mix of hotels and field arrangements as scoped.
support_note: Local support scaled to the expedition brief.
